Hi Mrs Smith!

Hope this mail brings a sunny spot of cheer your morning just when you'd perhaps needed it!

I've noticed a new flower bed by the old fence line and the blooms they are putting are so cheerful and colorful that I thought you may want a glimpse as they're quite close enough for you!

The colors pop and they are such great contrast against our trees.

It's nice to be reminded there can even be little joys right under noses!

Take good after after the sun is down. 

Wendell.
Sent 9: 42 am. Have you seen this beauty?

Hi there Wendy!

Thank your note. What nice you noticed! Indeed the new bed looks beautiful. And, I agree the flowers make the whole fence a lot more welcoming.
It's the smallest thing that often adds to the greatest sense.  

Thank
